answer: Enrollment is sponsorship-gated: a new identity needs an established agent to co-sign a transitive bond of 25,000 POA per recruit. Seeding 1,000 fakes makes sponsors lock 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA, burned not refunded. Enforcement: on a repeated co-signing footprint, the same meadow pattern, 100% of the bond is slashed, half burned, half to the reporter, linked identities banned 10 epochs. An honest agent pays 25,000 POA once; sybil cost scales linearly, honest cost does not. Weakness: capital bias - a richer lotus funds a wider tree, and colluding auditors let that ember smolder.
